cultural_history: Raghurajpur (SAARC Cultural Heritage Village) is the living centre of Odisha Pattachitra. Every household in its narrow lanes hosts a chitrakar family; the village also sustains gotipua dance, palm-leaf engraving and the making of masks for Krishna Leela. The art form has been practised here continuously for over six generations, and the village holds the focal claim of GI Application No. 88.

District-level hub of the Puri cluster: the town of Puri anchors the Jagannath temple ritual economy to which patta painting has been tethered for a millennium. Artisans travel here for festivals, exhibitions and temple commissions.
